purpose: Confirm that docvalue_fields adds a per-hit fields object which the gateway must not silently omit or synthesize from _source
environment: Separate single-node containers with security disabled
reproduction: Start each recorded image as an isolated single-node container with security disabled.
Create qeg_docvalue_probe_20261019 with the recorded mapping.
POST qeg_docvalue_probe_20261019/_search with request_with_doc_values and inspect the first hit's fields object.
Repeat with request_with_empty_list and verify the hit has no fields member.
Repeat with request_with_url_parameter and verify the first hit contains both requested fields.
Delete the temporary index from each engine.
limitations: This is request and response compatibility evidence, not a storage, memory, or latency benchmark.
The probe covers one single-valued keyword and one integer; it does not cover date formatting, wildcards, nested fields, multivalued fields, missing values, or custom doc-value settings.
The observed agreement applies only to Elasticsearch 8.15.0 and OpenSearch 3.9.0; no behavior is inferred for other versions.
No Qdrant endpoint was involved in the native observations. Gateway rejection is validated separately with a mocked upstream that records calls.
